benchmarks.item: High-quality mid-rise residential hard construction cost, Polanco V Sección / Mexico City (8 stories, underground parking). No public source located that states a directly applicable cost per m² for this exact typology and quality; numeric cost benchmark not reported.
benchmarks.unit: MXN per m² gross building area
benchmarks.source_title: BIMSA Costos; CMIC/CEICO Catálogo de Costos Directos de Vivienda 2025
benchmarks.note: BIMSA advertises paid access to parametric cost-per-m² models, but public page does not disclose figures. The CMIC/CEICO catalog is presented as a reference for direct housing costs; accessible public listing does not expose applicable cost values. Neither source supports a numeric high-quality 8-story Polanco project rate.

benchmarks.item: Underground parking / basement hard cost per m². No directly applicable published public cost value found.
benchmarks.unit: MXN per m² gross basement area
benchmarks.note: BIMSA lists parking among its parametric project categories, but does not publish numeric model outputs on its public page.

benchmarks.item: Annual construction cost escalation indicator: residential construction price change, Mexico, July 2025–July 2026
benchmarks.source_title: CEICO, Variaciones en el precio de la construcción residencial, agosto 2026 (based on INEGI)
benchmarks.note: National residential construction price inflation reported by CEICO using INEGI data. This is an index change, not a Polanco-specific forecast or project escalation allowance.
No sufficiently supported public benchmark found.
No sufficiently supported percentage benchmark found.

caveats: Benchmarks are not contractor quotations. Publicly accessible material reviewed did not provide a numeric cost-per-m² for the requested high-quality, 8-story Mexico City residential typology with underground parking; do not treat generic house-building rates as equivalent.
CMIC/CEICO reports national residential price movement; its published figure is not a cost level and should not be extrapolated as a Polanco-specific rate without project pricing.
The accessible CMIC/CEICO catalog says its direct-cost catalog is illustrative and based on average working conditions, with project-specific variables affecting results.

proposals.source_title: CEICO, Variaciones en el precio de la construcción residencial, agosto 2026 (based on INEGI)
proposals.note: Annual construction cost escalation indicator: residential construction price change, Mexico, July 2025–July 2026 (2026 (July; 12-month change)); range None–None % year over year. Estimate, not a contractor quote.
